caption:
Your financial accounts are for your personal use only. Protect yourself by keeping your login details private and never moving funds for others, even if they seem trustworthy. Recent RBI directions highlight the importance of account security to help prevent financial fraud. Context: RBI. Have you ever wondered how to spot signs of digital fraud? Let us know in the comments. Save this for later and share it with someone who needs it. #FinancialHealth #RXT #BankingSecurity #FinancialEducation #MoneyTips #PersonalFinance #CyberSafety
